articleTitle: DesignGPT: Multi-Agent Collaboration in Design
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Generative AI faces many challenges when entering the product design workflow, such as interface usability and interaction patterns. Therefore, based on design thinking and design process, we developed the DesignGPT multi-agent collaboration framework, which uses artificial intelligence agents to simulate the roles of different positions in the design company and allows human designers to collaborate with them in natural language. Experimental results show that compared with separate AI tools, DesignGPT improves the performance of designers, highlighting the potential of applying multi-agent systems that integrate design domain knowledge to product scheme design.

articleTitle: Elegami:Tangible Interactive Picture Book for children with Multimodal Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing interest among researchers in the field of educating children about electricity. However, introducing electrical knowledge during early basic education poses significant challenges. To address this issue, our study focuses on the design and development of a Tangible Interactive Picture Book specifically tailored for children aged 6-9 years old. By integrating electronic technology with the physical interaction provided by a pop-up book, we aim to enhance children’s understanding and learning of basic electrical concepts. Our design approach incorporates an adventure story, which presents electrical knowledge puzzles that can be solved through physical manipulation. This approach enables children to engage with and comprehend electricity more interactively. To evaluate the effectiveness of our product, we conducted a study involving 15 children within the target age group. The results revealed that the participants found our product, named "Elegami", to be more captivating compared to traditional science books, and they expressed higher levels of satisfaction. Consequently, Elegami effectively reduces the barriers to learning about electricity, facilitating an easier acquisition of basic electrical knowledge for preschoolers.

articleTitle: Research on user experience design of red cultural tourism based on Flow experience
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Red cultural tourism contains profound cultural heritage and value, which helps to spread and promote the revolutionary spirit, enhance national cultural confidence, and meet people's growing cultural consumption needs. Based on the flow theory, the development status, and the characteristics of red cultural tourism, we construct red cultural tourism scene stories to enhance the interaction and visual experience of red cultural tourism. We proposed a flow model of red cultural tourism and proposed the main contents and features of the interactive design platform from four aspects: clear tourism goals, balance of perceptual skills and challenges, user experience and spatial presence, and timely and effective feedback. Suggestions for optimizing the implementation process to enhance the vitality of China’s red culture and build cultural confidence. The platform aims to integrate red cultural tourism resources, provide publicity channels for red cultural tourist attractions, accurately match the development path of red cultural tourism, and bring good services to the public. The project research mainly takes red cultural tourism in Zhaoqing City as an example. Zhaoqing’s red culture has a profound heritage, rich forms of expression, and a wide range of audiences. Flow experience theory can help optimize the red cultural tourism interface design process and provide design strategies.

articleTitle: Exhaled Breath Analysis Based Diabetes Detection with k-Nearest Neighbors Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The diagnosis of early stages of diseases such as lung cancer or diabetes is challenging as those diseases don’t have many noticeable symptoms. The human breath, however, contains many VOCs (volatile organic compounds) that could be used as a clue for conducting the proper test. In this study, a custom breathalyzer device is developed for non-invasive detection and diagnosis of diabetes with the use of a human breath print. An array of 6 MOS sensors is used in the prototype to collect 8 VOCs of the breath print of the subjects. The k-nearest Neighbor algorithm is implemented to determine the likelihood of a disease. In the results, an accuracy of 93.6% was achieved.

articleTitle: Implementing Cultural Image and Narrative in Jewelry Design with AHP and TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper presents a quantitative design approach for integrating cultural image and narrative into jewelry design using the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ) methods, with Lingnan culture as example. By incorporating AHP and TRIZ, this study offers a systematic and data-driven method to guide the creative process in cultural and creative jewelry design. The paper highlights the significance of quantitative design methods in cultural and creative jewelry design, offering valuable insights for designers seeking to create culturally meaningful and marketable jewelry pieces. By integrating Lingnan culture with the AHP and TRIZ design method, this study contributes to the expanding field of cultural and creative product development, fostering a deeper appreciation and understanding of cultural heritage through contemporary jewelry design.

articleTitle: Research on modular station design to enhance the sense of decency in outdoor work environments
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Under the advocacy of the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals of decent work for all, it is particularly important to create a more decent working environment for outdoor workers. First, this study proposed possible directions for design by investigating and the needs of outdoor workers for a decent working environment, the current status and shortcomings of related research and practical assistance, as well as the research status of urban public facilities design. Then, based on the previous research and analysis, a modular urban post station was designed to enhance their sense of decency in outdoor work environments by meeting basic needs of outdoor workers during the work process. Finally, the effectiveness of the design was evaluated through structural equation model. The results indicated that the safety and convenience of the work environment significantly positively affected the sense of decency in it. Therefore, the modular station designed can improve the safety and convenience of the work environment by meeting the real-time needs of outdoor workers during their work process, thereby effectively enhancing the sense of decency in the work environment. It provides a method reference for providing decent work in outdoor public spaces, and enriches relevant research in the field of urban public facility design.

articleTitle: Research on Design Strategies for Promoting the Construction of Skilled Talents through Interest Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Currently, the constantly changing social and economic environment requires children to broaden their horizons, cultivate broad and accurate professional knowledge and skills, and fully respond to the complex reality of career development in the 21st century. This article refers to the cases of industrial poverty alleviation and educational poverty alleviation in precision poverty alleviation policies, and develops a general strategy framework led by design. The purpose of this strategy is to guide educators and designers to design "project courses", apply teaching aids to vocational experience courses, and bring better teaching effects to children. In order to verify the effectiveness of this strategy, this study will explore and showcase it in the form of case studies, and reveal how this strategy was developed from raising questions to providing reference for the cultivation of talents in other fields.

articleTitle: Research on Implicit Interaction Applied in Sneaker Laces Design
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper establishes a behavioral analysis model based on implicit interaction theory to provide reference and guidance for design practice using implicit interaction theory. Firstly, this paper conducted an overview research on the current stage of sneaker laces and implicit interaction theory through relevant literature; then it constructed a behavioral analysis model based on implicit interaction theory, and designed a running shoe that can adjust the elasticity of shoe laces according to the speed to promote the balance of the plantar pressure by conducting a more in-depth research on the changes of the foot during the process of high-intensity interval training and long-distance running, as well as combining with the proposed behavioral analysis model for the final design practice. A running shoe that can adjust the elasticity of the laces according to the speed to promote the balance of plantar pressure is designed.

articleTitle: Design of smart tourism platform under Double Diamond Model design thinking
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the context of digitalization, employing the dual-diamond model design thinking, we dissect the design of smart tourism systems to enhance user-centric experiences. Firstly, through a literature review, we delve into the concept and design process of the dual-diamond model while exploring the feasibility of digital technologies. Subsequently, harnessing the characteristics of the dual-diamond design thinking, we embark on the entire design process. During the exploration phase, we gather firsthand user pain points through user interviews, complemented by secondary data from the internet. This aids in constructing user journey maps and user models, defining user segments, and identifying design opportunities. Following this, we proceed with the functional reconstruction and interface prototyping of the smart tourism application, with a focus on features such as automated travel guides, visualized travel itineraries, panoramic guides, personalized travel companion searches, and intelligent user interactions. Conducting empirical design validation, we observed a high level of user satisfaction. Consequently, iterative design improvements were made, serving as a reference for future smart travel service promotion and development, thus advancing the growth of personalized tourism.

articleTitle: "Food provision during the outbreak" - the WeChat Mini Program for Material Supply Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Under the influence of the epidemic, in order to reduce the spread of the virus among the population, relevant departments have issued some epidemic prevention and control policies, restricting residents' shopping activities. Residents are unable to go to the mall to purchase goods by themselves, so they can use platforms such as the "Food provision during the outbreak" mini-program, Meituan, Ele.me, Hema Fresh, etc., to purchase necessary items. The mini-program is developed using WeChat Developer Tools. The front-end functions of this mini-program include the home page, store, search, messages, and personal modules, while the backend system includes the product procurement and delivery modules. The mini-program consists of three parts: the view layer, logic layer, and client. It adopts the MVC development pattern, and is composed of the client, mini-program API, database, and web server. The front-end of the mini-program is implemented using WXML,WXSS, and JavaScript.WXML is responsible for data binding and component style design, WXSS renders the component styles defined in WXML, and JavaScript handles application-level logic design. The backend of the mini-program uses MySQL database technology to organize and save data for ease of use.

articleTitle: A heat pump air conditioning simulation developmentplatform based on AMEsim and Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The study of energy consumption of heat pump air conditioning system in low temperature environment has become a popular research direction for air conditioning of electric vehicles(EV). At the current stage, system matching of air conditioning is time-consuming and expensive due to traditional development flow. This paper presented a platform based on co-simulation of Simulink and AMESim, by which heat pump air conditioning system can be simulated and matched under various working conditions.

articleTitle: A Mobile Application Design for the Popularization of Intangible Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The development of intangible cultural heritage in modern society is difficult. In order to facilitate the learning of intangible cultural heritage and promote the way of culture dissemination, this paper takes Zhejiang Province of China as an example to design a mobile application (APP) serving the popularization of intangible cultural knowledge, helping users get rid of the limitations of traditional learning and understand intangible cultural more systematically. The author sorted out relevant types of APP, and summarized specific design cases, verified the practicability of intangible cultural learning in application interaction, proposed design strategies, and finally formed the interface design scheme.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Beachcombing Service System Based on Marine Ecotourism Concept
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Marine ecotourism plays a vital role in the economic growth of peripheral coastal areas and islands. However, this growth presents challenges such as marine pollution, beach safety concerns, limited professional information, and an increase in destructive tourist activities that threaten marine organism sustainability. To address these issues, we have developed a service system that assists users in planning marine journeys and provides intelligent information including biometric identification and real-time tidal alerts. In this study, we applied a service design practice, integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Augmented Reality (AR) technologies, specifically focused on beachcombing activities. The mobile application incorporates gamification design to enhance user awareness of environmental protection and ecological sustainability. This system offers a secure and interactive experience, while also generating significant economic benefits for local fishermen and relevant industries by fostering the development of marine ecotourism.

articleTitle: A Novel Short-term Irradiance Forecasting Method based on Transformer Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Short-term solar irradiance forecasting plays a critical role in the effecitive integration of intermittent photovoltaic (PV) solar power into power grids. Existing research on short-term solar irradiance forecasting faces challenges such as instability and low computational efficiency. This study addressed this issue by proposing an improved compensated referenced transformer model. It focused on the region of interest according to the solar position and cloud velocity estimated using the optical flow technique. A sequence of VGG16 cloud features was used to train the transformer network with clear sky reference model. The experimental results show that our proposed method can reduce the normalised mean absolute percentage error of global horizontal irradiance prediction by 6.83%.

articleTitle: Service-oriented Smart Campus Takeout Ordering Service Platform Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Smart campus is an inevitable trend of technological innovation. Through practical research on the specific application of smart campus takeout ordering services, we will help the construction of smart campuses. The subject is based on service design principles. First, user needs are obtained through user research, user portraits are constructed, and user pain points and design opportunities in the three service stages of smart takeout service are summarized based on the user experience journey map to determine the service blueprint; then Conduct case analysis, conduct market positioning, optimize service functions such as fun interactions, personalized functions, and intelligent charts of dining services, and output an interactive interface solution for a smart takeout ordering system, which can effectively promote the dual improvement of service and management, and provide a smart campus Development services provide design reference.

articleTitle: Research on Ideation Process and Design Productivity of ChatGPT Based on LASSO and Linkography
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In design, good ideas are the source of a designer’s creativity. With the development of artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs) represented by ChatGPT shows excellent conversational and creative reasoning capabilities. However, we still know very little about the design ideation process and its performance in terms of productivity. In this paper, we propose a representation of the design ideation process based on NLP. On this basis, referring to LASSO and linkography method, we propose a DCLASSO model to calculate the interconnections between design moves in protocol analysis. In the subsequent experiment, we take the design protocols generated by ChatGPT as the experimental sample to verify the proposed model. Finally, with the generated linkographs, the characteristics of ChatGPT and human designers are analyzed and compared from aspects of design ideation process and design productivity.

articleTitle: Research on the Interaction Design of Online Crowdsourcing Platform Based on Emotionality: Human Centricity
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, the connection between design and emotion has gained significant attention in design research. A variety of research methods, models and theories have been introduced and applied to comprehensively investigate and elucidate the impact of the relationship between design and emotion, as well as how emotions can best be used in design. However, the variable-centered research method ignores the complex interactions of these variables at the individual level. This study adopts a human-centered analysis method that considers users’ emotions and desires as creative drivers, and combines emotional design theory to propose design strategies for the visceral, behavioral and reflective levels respectively. Subsequently, the Tuyi design platform serves as a case study to refine the platform in line with the proposed strategy. Usability testing is then conducted to evaluate the enhancement. The findings indicate that the design strategy significantly boosts the platform’s usability, thereby presenting a valuable foundation for future design initiatives.

articleTitle: A torque estimation method at Medium-High Speed for reciprocating electric compressor based on Gaussian process regression
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The distortion-free torque observation is fundamental to reciprocating electric compressors which is driven by permanent magnet synchronous motors [1] (PMSM), from optimizing the torque performance to speed control. Owing to the high cost associated with position sensor, parameter estimation is essential to improve the quality of the compressor control. However, in practice these evaluated data is not reliable at full range due to complex disturbulance. Here we report a strategy based on Gaussian process regression to reduce signal instability at medium-high speed for PMSM. Our studies suggest that adopting Gaussian process regression could facilitate more accurate torque and speed output by better-predicted torque variations.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Blockchain Technology in Malaysia and Singapore Financial Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Lately, in the technology industry we have seen an increase of utilizing blockchain technology and developing systems and solution to serve a purpose and sell certain product. Therefore, this study aimed in studying and determining the relationship between technology challenges, environment challenge, organization challenge, market factors with blockchain technology adoption. In this research, we employed non-random sampling methods to gather information from individuals ranging from 18 years old up to and including those aged 60 and above. We gathered a total of 200 responses via survey questionnaires. Both primary data from the questionnaires and secondary sources were used to ensure the dependability of our research data. Analytical results—including descriptive statistics, reliability checks, and inferential analysis—were generated using IBM SPSS software, version 25.0. The findings revealed a positive correlation between the challenges in technology, environment, organization, and market factors in relation to blockchain technology uptake. Among these variables, the organizational challenges demonstrated the most significant positive correlation with blockchain adoption. The concluding chapter of this study discusses the constraints faced during the research and offers suggestions for subsequent studies and investigations.

articleTitle: Refrigerator ingredients detection and recipe recommendation via NeSy-Mix
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the process of making refrigerators smarter, there have been functional deficiencies that resulted in a less-than-optimal user experience. This paper introduces a three-component neural-symbol fusion method called NeSy-Mix, aimed at creating a demonstration neural-symbol system for refrigerator food detection and recipe recommendation. The first component is the NeOD neural processing module, which incorporates the NeOD-YOLOv7 algorithm with IT data augmentation and ELAN-H-CBAM or object detection. The second component is the SyKG symbolic processing module, responsible for building a visual multi-modal knowledge graph by extracting and integrating knowledge concepts. The third component is the NeSy-Al module, which ensures alignment between the NeOD and SyKG components using a storage variable pool and label mapping. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in food ingredient recognition with an mAP value of 98.1% and a speed rate of 64.76fps, outperforming other algorithms. The constructed knowledge graph for Zhejiang cuisine recipes achieved an average quality level of 98.435%, an average alignment accuracy of 83.53%, a response time of 2.17s, and a user satisfaction rating of 4.05, thus validating the effectiveness of the NeSy-Mix method.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing The Use of Agri-Food E-Commerce (AE): An Analysis Of Malaysian Consumers
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The growing prominence of E-Commerce as a rapid means of facilitating trade, both domestically and internationally, has transformed consumer behavior and market dynamics. However, the viability of online sales extends to select product categories, leaving fresh agricultural products, notably vegetables, facing unique challenges due to the imperative of maintaining product freshness. Prolonged shipping times and temperature variations during transportation pose risks of spoilage, diminishing consumer interest. This research endeavors to uncover the factors influencing consumers' decisions to purchase fresh agricultural products online and explores the intricate relationship between online purchase intentions and the adoption of Agri-food E-Commerce (AE) in Malaysia. Employing questionnaire surveys for data collection, the study leverages SPSS and Smart-PLS for quantitative analysis. By enhancing the body of knowledge concerning AE, this research contributes essential insights into the landscape of online purchase intentions, AE adoption, and readiness in Malaysia. Additionally, it seeks to establish a comprehensive model of AE acceptance. These findings serve to stimulate informed discourse and engagement, fostering greater participation across the spectrum of fresh agricultural products. Ultimately, this research holds the potential to curtail food wastage, optimize supply-demand equilibrium, and inform consumption and production patterns within the AE framework

articleTitle: How important is Trust: Exploring the Factors Influencing College Students' Use of Chat GPT as a Learning Aid
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, its functions have become increasingly powerful. Large Language Models such as ChatGPT have solved various tasks such as text creation and code debugging, and the impact in the field of education has caused close attention from many scholars. Therefore, by establishing an extended TAM, we conducted a questionnaire survey on 470 college students to explore their acceptance of using ChatGPT as an auxiliary learning tool. Structural equation modeling (SEM) was used to analyze the data. The results showed that trust, facilitating conditions, perceived usefulness, and perceived ease of use have a positive impact on college students' use intention of ChatGPT. Hence, by improving the credibility of generated content and providing appropriate auxiliary resources will help promote students' acceptance of ChatGPT. The research results provide suggestions and directions for future design.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Second Brain: Enhancing Large Language Models through Chain of Thought with Human Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The expansion of large language models has led to improved performance and efficiency, with prompt engineering emerging as a key strategy for various LLM tasks. However, while these methods have proven beneficial, they are not without their constraints, particularly when it comes to sustaining a comprehensive, logical flow of ideas throughout the entire reasoning process. Despite the effectiveness of the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Tree-of-Thought (ToT) methods, they have limitations due to their end-to-end reasoning process. To address this, we introduce the chain-of-thought with human feedback. This new method incorporates human feedback into the model’s reasoning process, allowing for real-time adjustments and optimization. This approach fosters a more interactive and dynamic model operation, enabling the model to learn from human intuition and expertise, and improve its reasoning process over time. We have validated the effectiveness of our method through experiments in GSM8K and MMLU. Our main contributions include proposing the first human feedback to the chain of thought and the development of an intuitive interface for individuals to utilize large-scale models for problem-solving.

articleTitle: A study on consumer sentiment in pet food e-commerce based on UGC
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper crawls online data of different products on e-commerce platforms through crawler technology. In the data processing stage, the LDA topic model is used to text-process the original review data and summarize the subjective dimensions to which different consumers’ online reviews belong. The BiLSTM model is then introduced to learn the features of the textual utterance data, thus realizing the effect of autonomous induction of topic categories by feature words. Finally, the sentiment scores of the evaluated utterances that have been clarified by the subject are performed by SnowNLP. After getting the sentiment score, the topic dimension-feature word-sentiment score is combined. Through the quantitative analysis results of categorized and summarized, the evaluation dimensions and influencing factors affecting consumer satisfaction in the pet market are studied and discussed, and the important indicators affecting consumer satisfaction are summarized and summarized. It also proposes market recommendations based on the analysis results for types of market players, consumers and e-commerce platform.

articleTitle: Determinants of Privacy Policy on Social Media Site: Comparison between Weibo and Facebook
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, the number of users of social media is still increasing and the consequences of neglected privacy policies are becoming more and more obvious. This research aims to determine the relationship between several factors, which are profit, management, readability, comprehension, private data control, with users’ trust level in social media by the determinants of the privacy policy. Non-probability sampling techniques were used in this study to collect data from Facebook/Weibo users. A total of 256 questionnaires have been collected. To provide reliable data for the research, primary data such as survey questionnaires and secondary data were used. The descriptive analysis, reliability test, and inferential analysis results were obtained using SPSS version 25, and they can be useful for this research. At the conclusion of this study, it was discovered that there is a positive relationship between profit, readability, comprehension, and private data control and trust. Furthermore, attitude influences destination image and travel intention. It is hoped that the findings will provide some useful insights for social media service providers, Malaysian and Chinese government sectors, and future researchers.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 for Appearance Defect Detection in Polyester Fiber Yarn Packages
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Polyester fiber yarn packages often exhibit various appearance defects during production, including six classes: hairiness, hairiness clusters, broken thread, broken pipe, oil stains, and dust impurities. Failure to detect these defects in time during the production process can lead to significant economic losses. This highlights the importance of real-time detection of yarn packages defects during production. Currently, there are some problems with methods that rely mainly on manual testing, such as high false positive rates and poor timeliness. In order to address the increasing complexity of defect detection in the appearance of yarn packages, in this study, 2480 datasets of size 2448*512 were first collected on the production line, and defect detection was explored using the popular YOLOv5 model and the newer YOLOv8 model. The performance of the model at different scales was also evaluated. The results show that YOLOv8 is better than YOLOv5 in this task and is more suitable for industrial applications. Our study provides an efficient and accurate quality control method for the production of Polyester fiber yarn packages.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning Based Text Classification Method for Product Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Product review data analysis has important commercial and research values. This paper proposes a deep transfer learning framework and an adaptive deep transfer model for cross-domain classification of commodity reviews. The method is based on adaptive linear kernel function and conditional distribution adaptation method based on homogeneous transfer, and gradually reveals the discriminative structures of the target domain and learns the cross-domain invariant representation of text features. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and robustness in cross-domain product review classification tasks, providing an effective solution for cross-domain product review classification.

articleTitle: Design of Photovoltaic Cleaning Robots Assisted by Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the booming development of the photovoltaic (PV) industry, the cleaning of PV panels has become increasingly crucial. This study, framed under the double diamond model, utilized the large language model (LLM) GPT-4 to assist in designing a PV cleaning robot. Initially, the study involved in-depth market analysis and field investigations to identify consumer needs and design requirements. Subsequently, the Kano model was applied to effectively categorize and assess consumer needs, successfully pinpointing key design directions. GPT-4 proposed numerous innovative design ideas. We created the selected prototypes to test and chose the most promising one ultimately. The results indicate that the overall performance of the scheme met expectations, demonstrating the potential of LLMs in complex product design.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Online Public Opinion Evolution based on Configuration Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: [Background] With the continuous iteration of information technology, traditional social media platforms have gradually broken away from the original restrictions, attracting more and more netizens to express their opinions and attitudes. However, the ensuing new media environment also brings new challenges to the guidance and governance of online public opinion. Whether we can grasp the evolution trend of public opinion has become a key issue that needs to be solved in the current management of online public opinion. [Methods] Based on this, this paper selects 48 typical cases, adopts fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis, and extracts six factors affecting the evolution of online public opinion popularity based on information ecology theory and life cycle theory (Event type, Authority of the publishing subject, Media engagement, Influence of opinion leaders, Netizens’ activity level, Government deconcentration power). Based on this, it analyzes how the factors and their internal mechanisms drive the evolution of online public opinion. [Conclusion] The results show that the evolution of online public opinion popularity is not determined by a single factor, but is the result of multiple symbiotic interactions. Moreover, the media and the government have played a role in the evolution of online public opinion.

Author Keywords: evolution of online public opinion heat
fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis method

articleTitle: The Design of Coral Protection Game Based on Sustainability Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Over the past few decades, coral coverage has declined significantly in many areas of southern China. Human activities have severely degraded coral reef environments, leading to the demise of coral and related organisms. To make young people aware of this crisis, we develop the game, Save Coral, using a game-based sustainability learning model. The game conveys the severity of the coral crisis and the difficulty of restoring coral reef ecosystems. We conduct a user study. The results of the study show that most participants play video games regularly and have taken action to protect the environment. However, they are largely unaware of the coral crisis. Save Coral is a user-friendly tool to increase their understanding and reflection on the coral crisis. We will continue to improve the game based on their feedback.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Interactive Sex Education Products for Children from the Perspective of Comprehensive Sexuality Education
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: China presently lacks sufficient sex education resources for schools and families due to a delayed initiation of sex education. The concept of Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) provides guidance for developing and designing sexuality education resources. This study employed the KJ method and interviews to assess existing sex education products. It introduced the idea of tailored design for 6-8-year-olds by integrating CSE content. Prototypes were utilized for iterative refinement. Thirty children evaluated the final prototype, demonstrating that CSE- based design effectively met children's satisfaction and sparked their enthusiasm for learning.

articleTitle: MathForest: A Tangible Collaborative Game for Developing Children’s Spatial Skills
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Many children exhibit low spatial skills due to a lack of motivation and effective learning methods, which adversely affects their future performance in STEM fields. We designed MathForest, a tangible collaborative game, to cultivate spatial skills by encouraging children to communicate through spatial language. The MathForest system consists of an identification board, level cards, tangram and an iPad-based game. Participants work in pairs, leveraging their understanding of coordinate systems and geometric transformations to verbally describe or physically complete tangram puzzles. Finally, our user study demonstrated that learning collaboratively through the use of spatial language positively affects children’s development of spatial skills.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Asymmetric Game Between Lawyers and Clients
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This article studies the interest constraint relationship between lawyers and clients, constructs a game model under information asymmetry, and proposes that regulatory agencies should increase their supervision and punishment efforts to prevent lawyers from misleading clients to obtain high profits by model solving and analysis. This article also proposes that it is necessary to establish an open information exchange service platform, form a cooperative relationship of negotiation and interaction, and alleviate information asymmetry in the litigation market.

articleTitle: Exploring Factors Influencing the Acceptance of Digitalized Smart Campus Cafeteria Models: A UTAUT Model-Based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid evolution of the Internet and continuous advancements in information technology, various emerging technologies and devices are reshaping higher education institution cafeterias. Specifically, there is a notable trend towards digitization and informatization in constructing these campus dining facilities. Consequently, smart campus cafeterias have gained prominence and witnessed widespread adoption and development.This study selected the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) as the foundational framework to explore the determinants influencing university students’ acceptance of smart campus cafeterias. The empirical research adapted four key variables - performance expectation, effort expectation, social influence, and facilitating condition, alongside newly introduced variables of relative advantage, individual innovation, and behavioral intention.Building upon these research findings, strategies and recommendations were proposed at multiple levels, including platform development companies, and institutional and governmental perspectives.

articleTitle: Enhancing Urban Night Riding Safety Through Equipment Design from a Health Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The research aims to develop effective safety measures for night cycling to enhance the safety and health attributes of this popular urban sport. By exploring safety theories and existing technology, three types of safety solutions are proposed. The research evaluates the risk avoidance ability of the warning seat solution through sound and vibration prompts, confirming its effectiveness in ensuring safety during night riding. This redesign emphasizes active safety measures, offering a new direction and theoretical reference for night riding protective equipment design.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Algorithms for Film and Television Programs Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to improve the problems of low accuracy and narrow information filtering in traditional recommendation algorithms. In this paper, a hybrid recommendation algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. which integrates feedforward neural network, recurrent neural network, and content-based deep learning recommendation algorithm, uses the public dataset MovieLens-1M, combines the user and film and television text information and scoring information in the dataset, uses the neural network to extract features from text descriptions, and completes personalized recommendation through feature calculation. The algorithm is evaluated by MAE, RMSE and other indicators, and the evaluated values can reach less than 1, and the evaluation performance is good.

articleTitle: Creative Thinking Stimulates Innovation Design of CAM Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: CAM mechanism is widely used in engineering, it can realize the arbitrary and complex motion curve of the follower [1]. The typical design method of CAM pitch curve is based on the principle of inversion [2], [3]. In the process of designing CAM, the author uses creative thinking [4] to raise the question whether the design steps based on the inversion principle can be applied "in reverse". Based on this problem, the author takes the plate CAM mechanism with translating knife-edge follower as an example and verifies the design results of CAM pitch curve through two different motion curves. The results show that the inverse application on the principle of the inversion method does not change the CAM pitch curve.

articleTitle: Comparison of cognitive improvement between finger exergame and traditional exercise in elderly with mild cognitive impairment: A randomized controlled trial
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Previous studies have shown that finger exercise has a positive impact on cognitive retention and recovery in older adults with mild cognitive impairment(MCI). In this study, we developed a finger exergame based on OpenPose to study the difference between exergame and traditional exercise in improving cognitive function in elderly people with MCI. 20 eligible elderly individuals were randomly assigned to an experimental group (with 10 participants undergoing intervention using finger exergames.) and a control group (with 10 participants receiving treatment through traditional methods.). The results showed that our exergame was superior to traditional exercises in terms of improving cognition. The findings of this study support the potential application of OpenPose-based serious exergames as a promising tool for cognitive enhancement in the elderly population.

articleTitle: Bilateral Anomaly Detection Based on Edge Computing: Baseboard Management Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Anomaly detection on servers is a crucial technique with the increment of computing patterns in this period. To accommodate current demands, we propose a version of a bilateral detection scheme based on the baseboard management controller with machine learning to conduct compound anomaly detection and boost the upper bound. On the local part, the naive logic trees are deployed on the calculating module to make initial detection and carry out prompt actions maintaining the applicable working environment. Once the local anomaly alerts, the remote part is triggered to judge with the Gaussian Mixture Model, which ensures the anomaly type and proceeds with advanced steps. The bilateral detection system resorts to edge computing priority and scientifically allocates computing power to improve the level of anomaly detection on servers. The anomaly detection system’s effect herein is excellent in real-time demand and stability.

articleTitle: Healthful Sleep Solutions: Intelligent Sleep Products Design Based on the Active Health Concept
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Busy urban empty-nesters, exposed to prolonged artificial light, experience disrupted circadian rhythms and sleep issues. This study aims to address these problems by developing a smart sleep health product and integrated bedroom system. Grounded in active health principles, this design combines bedding and lighting systems to combat rhythm disruptions and discourage late-night activities. By analyzing engineering factors and integrating design elements seamlessly, a strategic approach is formulated. Prototype evaluation demonstrates its efficacy in improving sleep quality with aesthetic appeal. In conclusion, this intelligent sleep health design, based on active health, effectively regulates circadian rhythms in urban empty-nesters, alleviates sleep disorders, and informs intelligent health design practices.

articleTitle: Melody Oasis: Research and Design of a Nature Interactive System for Children Based on Plant Electrical Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the Post-Epidemic Era, with the development of the Internet and the birth of various new entertainment methods, children are disconnected from nature. To promote the connection between children and nature, we proposes "Melody Oasis", a nature interactive system based on plant electrical signals. By integrating music with plants, it aims to stimulate children’s nature empathy during their interactions with plants. We invited 12 children to test the effectiveness of the system, and the results showed that Melody Oasis increased children’s interest in nature and stimulated their curiosity about nature. Melody Oasis serves as a link between children and nature, and facilitates the connection between urban-dwelling children and the natural world.

articleTitle: Improved Gravitational Search Algorithm with Elite Local Exploitation and Enlarged Gravity Constant
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The Newtonian gravity laws serve as the foundation for the gravitational search algorithm (GSA). It employs the gravitational force to govern the interaction and evolution of individuals. Despite achieving notable success, conventional GSA suffers from premature convergence and limited search ability. To address these issues, we propose an improved gravitational search algorithm with elite local exploitation and enlarged gravity constant (EGSA), which incorporates an elite local search strategy. This strategy enhances the algorithm’s ability to escape local optima and accelerates convergence. Using the IEEE CEC2017 benchmark test functions, we compare the effectiveness of the proposed approach to that of the current GSA variations.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Method for Scams Detection Among Micro Enterprises: A Design Science Research Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A key step in enterprise risk management is risk assessment (RA). However, there have been very few studies on how RA can be used to detect potential scams in the real world. The research is based on Design Science Research Methodology (DSRM) to lead the design process, where the artefact’s design and development will be the research’s major output, to discover the potential scam and evaluate the impact. To gain insight into how RA can be utilised to recognise potential scams, the researcher first engaged with the primary informant, Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM), in an interview. The purpose of the interview was to determine whether RA might be used to spot suspicious scam activities among micro enterprises. During the interview, the key informant stated that micro enterprises lack the financial literacy and scam-related knowledge necessary to detect suspicious activity prior to falling victim. Therefore, the goal of this study is to provide tools that can aid the prevention of financial fraud and guide micro enterprises through scam recognition. The creation of a methodology that concentrated on the internal interaction between RA and Fuzzy Set Theory (FST) was the first artefact. A guide was used to present the second item. To construct the artefacts, the researcher modified the DSRM by identifying the RA components and procedures that could be incorporated into the artefacts, integrating them with the FST, and modifying the Fuzzy Approach Risk Assessment Matrix (FRAM) snapshot as the foundation for presenting the artefacts’ outcomes.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral image deblurring based on joint utilization of spatial-spectral information
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) provide abundant spatial and spectral information simultaneously and can be used for various tasks. However, HSIs suffer from blurring and noise during imaging due to the imaging system, relative motion, etc. HSI deblurring is to deal with such problems. Most existing HSI deblurring methods iteratively optimize the problems with spatial and spectral regularizations, which do not effectively utilize the joint spatial-spectral information in the HSI. They are also time-consuming and difficult to be used practically. To address the above issues, we propose an end-to-end HSI deblurring network, Joint Spatial-Spectral Deblurring (JSSD), that combines Wiener filters with a deep convolutional neural network to utilize information in the spatial and spectral domain of the HSI jointly. Compared with the existing HSI deblurring schemes, our method can achieve much better restoration performance while consuming less time.

articleTitle: Digital Technology in Promoting Stakeholders Transforming in Cultural Inheritance
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Digital technology has changed the traditional "oral teaching" environment in Chinese culture and has become an important means to promote cultural inheritance. Researchers are more focused on digital cultural protection and development to facilitate professionals' use of cultural resources and attract the general public’s attention to culture. While people have been treated as objects and only become passive recipients of digital cultural products. However, people are considered the core of Chinese cultural inheritance and the key is to let more of the public become inheritors. Digital technology needs to consider how to facilitate the transformation of people. Through literature research, this study has analyzed different stakeholders of Chinese cultural inheritance. And using Bakhtin's theory of "dialogue", the transforming strategy of different stakeholders has been built. Based on the transforming strategy and case studies, the stakeholders’ transforming paths by digital technology have been constructed. In this way, this study has provided a holistic perspective on using digital technology to promote cultural inheritance.

articleTitle: Research on Intergenerational Affinity Products Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A comprehensive and objective intergenerational product design model based on AHP hierarchical analysis is established to provide theoretical basis and guidance for designing intergenerational affectionate interactive products. Firstly, through relevant literature research and market product analysis and target user interviews, we obtain each user demand index in the design of intergenerational products. Then the user matrix constructed by AHP hierarchical analysis is used to analyze the different user needs in the intergenerational scenario, the user demand matrix is constructed by questionnaire survey method and AHP hierarchical analysis method, the weight value of each user demand index is calculated and the consistency test is completed. The matrix constructed through the AHP hierarchical method yields one target layer, three first-level indicators, and 15 second-level indicators for the functional demand indicators of the next-generation products. Then, the design was carried out according to the importance level derived from AHP, and the final weights of the AHP outputs were used to evaluate the program and select the highest rated product. Finally, an intergenerational family interaction product was designed by combining research findings and design practices.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Question-Answering Systems Based on Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence and cloud computing technologies, the emergence of large language models (LLMs) has created new opportunities for intelligent applications. However, large language models may lack authenticity and accuracy when providing answers in specific professional domains, and they even generate "illusory facts." In response to the limitations of current large language models in solving specific professional fields, this paper proposes to use large language models and knowledge graph technology to construct an intelligent question answering system for specific fields. Through systematic training and optimization, efficient domain specific knowledge Q&A has been achieved, improving the satisfaction rate of domain specific knowledge Q&A. The intelligent question answering system based on large models and knowledge graphs brings more convenience to people's lives and work, which is beneficial for users to obtain intelligent solutions in fields such as education, healthcare, and customer service.

articleTitle: Identifying Chinese Calligraphy Styles by Simple Stroke Yi
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Chinese calligraphy, is the essence of Chinese culture, and it contains a variety of different styles. However, distinguishing these styles is not so easy. In order to study the key elements that distinguish calligraphy styles, we constructed the regular script character libraries from six calligraphers and concatenated four groups: entire Chinese characters, simple strokes “Yi”, structural strokes, and mixed groups. Using an innovative gamified voting method, we collected data from students on the calligraphy styles they used to differentiate. Through the multi-dimensional scaling algorithm, we used spatial distribution diagrams to describe the differentiation results of these four different groups in Chinese calligraphy styles. The research results show that the simple stroke “Yi” is indeed enough to distinguish different calligraphy styles. This challenges the previous belief that only the whole character can determine the expression of calligraphy style. Our research “Seeing the entire surface through one dot” can distinguish calligraphy styles with simple strokes, which will provide new opinions on the artistic aesthetics of Chinese calligraphy.

articleTitle: Digital Bionic Design of Dinner Plates Based on the Concrete Form of Qingming Riverside Map
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The emergence of the new generation of information technology has revolutionized the expression of product design, just as digital technology has opened up innovative avenues for bionic design. The application of bionic design in digital art not only enhances products with a multi-sensory aesthetic experience but also infuses them with vitality. Drawing inspiration from Qingming Riverside Map during the Song Dynasty, which is rooted in traditional Chinese culture, serves as a concrete prototype for bionic design. Subsequently, digital modeling technology is employed to shape and refine the product form, ultimately resulting in a tangible and digitally enhanced bionic design for the dinner plates. This approach offers a novel methodology and fresh perspective on integrating daily necessities design with traditional culture.

articleTitle: A Multi-Element Intelligent Flat Design Generation Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Computer-aided design systems play a pivotal role in graphic packaging design. This study seeks to enhance design freedom and personalization of generated schemes by integrating design elements with image aesthetics computation approaches, and furnishing users with suggestions on element positioning and color coordination. A background pattern generation model enabling style transfer is constructed to offer original and diverse backdrops for packaging designs encompassing novel tobacco products. By extracting relative layout modes of texts and product images, guidance is conferred regarding layout in packaging design. Additionally, genetic algorithm-enabled exploration into text color schemes informs color matching in packaging design, rendering the design process more explicit and maneuverable. This investigation elucidates intelligent generation in packaging design domains, encompassing novel tobacco products.

articleTitle: An Investigation into Aesthetic Assessment and Implementation Approaches for Graphic Design
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This study assessed visual clutter by computing feature congestion to provide guidance for layout design of novel tobacco product packaging. Color schemes for short phrases were searched using genetic algorithms to provide guidance for appearance color selection of novel tobacco products. The research demonstrated that introducing aesthetic evaluation criteria in intelligent generation for graphic design can produce design solutions more aligned with aesthetics. Finally, a general framework was proposed for intelligent visual design generation based on computational aesthetics, providing guidance for other categories of graphic design including novel tobacco products. This study laid a theoretical foundation for the research and development of intelligent generation systems for graphic design based on computational aesthetics.

articleTitle: Research on factors influencing the high-quality development of red culture in Zhaoqing and development strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Red culture is an important part of Chinese culture. The development of red culture tourism aims to enhance the cultural confidence and national spirit of the Chinese people and is also conducive to showing a good urban style. Through literature research, we explore the connotation of high-quality development, and are guided by the new development concept of "innovation, coordination, green, openness, and sharing". Taking Zhaoqing as an example, from the perspective of tourists, work focusing on personnel, environment, red culture itself, and other aspects, it elaborates on the problems and challenges faced by the development of red culture at the current stage, discusses the reasons and influencing factors that hinder its high-quality development, and proposes a high-quality development strategy for Zhaoqing red culture. Research shows that red research and resource endowment have a positive impact on high-quality development, and infrastructure has a potential impact on high-quality development. Infrastructure will significantly affect tourists ’ cultural tourism experience and soft service experience. There is a strong correlation between infrastructure, resource endowment, and red research.

articleTitle: WordDiffuser: Helping Beginners Cognize and Memorize Glyph-Semantic Pairs Using Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper delves into symbolic cognition, emphasizing the evolution from ancient hieroglyphs to modern abstract characters. Acknowledging the cultural importance and learning challenges associated with these abstract characters, we propose WordDiffuser, an AI-aided framework generating images to help beginners understand the relationship between abstract characters and their meanings. Our research includes a review of the role of semantic association in education, an investigation identifying market shortcomings, and the creation of an interactive learning website. The effectiveness of our approach is substantiated through an experiment involving 22 participants, showing considerable improvements in abstract character recognition and memorization. This study paves the way for further advancements in technology-assisted learning of symbolic systems.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>
